envelope.reason: what the unit could not prove and a finding beside the path

payload.title: purview contest unproven on the omp bridge
payload.body: purview-contest proves the contest on the worker in both harness forms, but not through the omp bridge itself: a contested fire consumes the .contest and prints its notice in the STANCE_EMIT_PAYLOAD pass, which render.ts relays as a non-JSON line (L1157-1160); no omp run was made. The unit also dropped the PURVIEW_GUARD_LOG misses.log from the purview worker (every fail-open already says so through say) to fit the 8192-byte bound; judge_keep and judge_cut remain in the shared clip though purview uses neither.
